title: InvChat
description: Adds chat button to inv gui, works on chests, shulkers, etc.
body:
adds a chat box to all inventory screens so you can send messages without closing your inventory.

**Features**
- Press **Tab** to focus the chat box while any inventory is open
- Type normally — keybinds like E won't close the screen while typing
- Press **Enter** to send, **Escape** to cancel
- Supports chat messages and `/commands`
- Configurable position and width via `config/inventorychat.json`

**Usage**
1. Open any inventory, chest, shulker, etc.
2. Press **Tab** to focus the chat field at the bottom of the screen
3. Type your message and press **Enter**

Compatible with **Fabric 1.21.4**.
